implementation: TI SimpleLink WiFi Networking Subsystem Crypto Module WolfSSL Component
description: The TI SimpleLink Wi-Fi Family brings highly secured connectivity solutions for embedded Wi-Fi and Internet of Things applications. It consists of a Wi-Fi network and security processor subsystem, a Wi-Fi driver, multiple internet protocols in ROM and ARM Cortex-M4 application microcontroller with a rich set of peripherals.
